user.title: Connect Chaptarr + Audiobookshelf
user.description: Credentials stay in Home Assistant; the books card never sees them.

data.auto_send: Automatically send new ebooks to tolino
data.sync_progress_write: Also write reading progress to tolino (experimental)

data_description.abs_token: Token of a dedicated, restricted Audiobookshelf user (Settings → Users), not the admin
data_description.komga_url: e.g. http://192.168.1.10:25600 - for the manga card. Leave empty for no manga section.
data_description.komga_api_key: Komga -> Account Settings -> API Keys. Use a dedicated Komga user WITHOUT admin rights.
data_description.mylar_url: e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8090 - to search and download manga. Leave empty for no download section.
data_description.mylar_api_key: Mylar -> Settings -> Web Interface -> API (enable it there first).
data_description.tolino_url: tolino-bridge address, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8199. Leave empty to keep the share-sheet fallback.
data_description.tolino_token: Value of secrets/bridge_token (deploy.sh token on Unraid)
data_description.auto_send: Every 10 minutes, ebooks that newly appear in Audiobookshelf (EPUB/PDF; MOBI/AZW3 are converted by the bridge) are sent to the tolino Cloud. Only books added AFTER you switch this on; your existing library is never touched. Needs the tolino bridge. Off by default.
data_description.sync_progress: Imports the reading position and 'finished' state of books you sent to tolino into Audiobookshelf (and so the card), every 10 minutes. Only books sent through this integration; a newer Audiobookshelf state is never overwritten. Needs the tolino bridge. Off by default.
data_description.sync_progress_write: Needs the option above. Sends the reading position and 'finished' state from Audiobookshelf (what you read in the card) to the tolino Cloud, so the reader continues there. Only books sent through this integration; the newer state wins. Off by default.
data_description.rescue_imports: Assigns downloads that Chaptarr blocks because of a same-series title mix-up to the book they were grabbed for
data_description.notify_service: Notify entity (e.g. notify.iphone_von_max) or notify service (e.g. notify.mobile_app_iphone_von_max); separate several with commas. Notified when an automatic repair fails.
data_description.debug_logging: Logs every proxied request at debug level

user.title: Add person
user.description: Every person gets their own accounts, so nobody can change somebody else's reading progress. Empty fields = the shared account from the main settings.

data_description.ha_user: Whoever signs in to Home Assistant with this account.
data_description.komga_api_key: Komga -> Account Settings -> API Keys of this person. Empty = the shared account from the main settings.
data_description.abs_token: Audiobookshelf -> this person's user -> API token. Empty = the shared account from the main settings.
data_description.notify_service: e.g. notify.mobile_app_annas_phone - this is where "your book is here" goes. Separate several with commas.
data_description.tolino: Shows "send to tolino" and runs auto-send and progress sync with this person's account. Needs a bridge in the main settings.
data_description.notify_test: Sends a test message to the notification target when saving.
